provenance.rationale: Bounded current-visit P1 continuity over the two unchanged R38 ROI complements. Only serialized terrain owners 47–52 provide P1 coverage and terrain support; all package P0 road faces remain excluded from fill and available as road support. If same-owner terrain hits disagree by more than 2 mm, canonical target-tile route S/U selects a coherent visit chart within explicit 1 m station / 0.05 m lateral windows; sole or already-consistent face support keeps its actual height and chart offsets remain diagnostic. This duplicates measured foreign owner 03 P1 coverage (0.660616387 m² total) in a new package-local estimated patch; it does not claim zero overlap or global terrain ownership. The ROI extents remain estimates, not surveyed land boundaries. R46 appends two R45-derived bounded components while preserving the original R44 regions and mesh prefix. R47 derives additional height-support samples by linear interpolation along existing serialized selected-P1 and P0 triangle edges at spacing no greater than 1 m. Original faces, positions, ROI coverage, and the four-neighbor 4 m estimate gate remain unchanged; edge samples are derived support values, not independent measurements or a DEM.

supplementary_inputs.limitation: not historical source-video registration and not survey-grade land ownership

r42c_route_attribute_chart.source: target-owner serialized tile49 road triangle attributes
r42c_route_attribute_chart.policy: For newly appended land-infill vertices within 0.02m of tile49 road faces, assign _ROUTE_S/_ROUTE_U by unrestricted affine barycentrics at the vertex original world XZ. Do not snap/clamp positions or copy foreign-owner route attributes.
r42c_route_attribute_chart.purpose: Prevent false route-relative road-band validation overlaps caused by chord projection at curved road edges; XYZ and surface faces remain unchanged.

r45_extension.rationale: Two additional s12390 references had zero serialized selected-P1/all-P0 XZ coverage. 0.25m center-sampled components were bounded and expanded by 1m; resulting rectangles are estimated local continuity ROIs, not surveyed boundaries. Contemporary OSM is supplementary only.

r47_edge_support.source: existing serialized selected-P1 owners 47–52 and all package P0 triangle edges
r47_edge_support.policy: linear barycentric interpolation of XYZ and route S/U along each existing face edge; no source face/position changes; distinct chart samples remain separate

terrain_support_chart.source: target tile 49 canonical route projection compared with serialized selected-P1 face attributes

height_rule.description: At supported points prefer tile49 road P0, then selected visit P1 owners 47–52, then other all-package P0 roads under this explicit policy. When multiple same-owner/layer P1 faces disagree by more than the unchanged 2 mm bound, use the canonical target-tile route chart to select faces within the stated station/lateral gates, then enforce that same 2 mm bound; sole or already-consistent support keeps the actual face height and records chart offsets. Use only selected P1 and all P0 support samples for the unchanged four-neighbor, 4 m inverse-square continuity rule. Foreign owner 03 P1 is deliberately excluded from coverage and support, and its duplicated footprint/height difference is reported separately. Route S/U for appended points uses the R42c target tile49 road-face affine chart within 20 mm, with no clamping or position changes. For height support only, add linearly interpolated samples along existing selected-P1 and all-P0 face edges at spacing ≤1 m. Existing source vertices remain included; chart-distinct samples are not averaged. This does not change coverage subtraction or the four-neighbor, 4 m IDW bound.
